name: Idris, Soul of the TARDIS
oracle_text:
Vanishing 3
Imprint — When Idris enters, exile another artifact you control until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Idris has all activated and triggered abilities of the exiled card and gets +X/+X, where X is the exiled card's mana value.
blocked_sentences: Idris has all activated and triggered abilities of the exiled card and gets +X/+X, where X is the exiled card's mana value.

needs.what: a static that lends the source the triggered abilities (as well as the activated ones) printed on a card linked to it in exile (607.2a), firing as the source's own triggers while the card stays exiled with it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_exiled_abilities (Hazel's Brewmaster) hands over only activated abilities: exiled_activated_abilities in engine/characteristics.py filters on ability.is_activated, so the exiled artifact's triggered abilities would be silently dropped

needs.what: a static magnitude reading the mana value of the card(s) linked to the source in exile (exiled_with: self), for a buff whose power and toughness are that mana value
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_value_keys has count, counters_on, sum and extreme_value over battlefield filters but nothing that reads the printed mana value of a card the source exiled; pump on the enters trigger would wear off and would not track the card leaving exile
